attributes.name: role
attributes.description:
Sets a role attribute to the root element. It must be a landmark role or group.
To prevent Splide from assigning the default value (region), pass an empty string or undefined.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Sets an aria-label attribute to the root element. This option overwrites the attribute defined by HTML.

attributes.name: labelledby
attributes.description: Sets an aria-labelledby attribute to the root element. This option overwrites the attribute defined by HTML.

attributes.name: rewind
attributes.description: Determines whether to rewind the carousel or not. This does not work in the loop mode.

attributes.name: speed
attributes.description: The transition speed in milliseconds. If 0, the carousel immediately jumps to the target slide.

attributes.name: rewindSpeed
attributes.description: The transition speed on rewind in milliseconds. The speed value is used as default.

attributes.name: rewindByDrag
attributes.description: Allows users to rewind a carousel by drag. The rewind option must be true.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Defines the carousel max width, accepting the CSS format such as 10em, 80vw.

attributes.name: fixedWidth
attributes.description: Fixes width of slides, accepting the CSS format. The carousel will ignore the perPage option if this value is provided.

attributes.name: fixedHeight
attributes.description: Fixes height of slides, accepting the CSS format except for %. The carousel will ignore perPage, height and heightRatio options if this value is provided.

attributes.name: autoWidth
attributes.description: If true, the width of slides are determined by their width.

attributes.name: perMove
attributes.description: Determines the number of slides to move at once.

attributes.name: clones
attributes.description: Specifies the number of clones on each side of the loop carousel.

attributes.name: cloneStatus
attributes.description: Determines whether to add the is-active class to clones or not.

attributes.name: paginationDirection
attributes.description: Explicitly sets the pagination direction that does not only affect appearance but also shortcuts and ARIA attributes. The default value is determined by the carousel direction. Accepts 'ltr' | 'rtl' | 'ttb'

attributes.name: easing
attributes.description: The timing function for the CSS transition, such as linear, ease or cubic-bezier().

attributes.name: noDrag
attributes.description: Snaps the closest slide in the drag free mode.

attributes.name: flickPower
attributes.description: Determines the power of "flick". The larger number this is, the farther the carousel runs.

attributes.name: flickMaxPages
attributes.description: Limits the number of pages to move by the flick action.

attributes.name: waitForTransition
attributes.description: Determines whether to disable any actions while the carousel is transitioning. Even if false, the carousel forcibly waits for the transition on the loop points.

attributes.name: arrowPath
attributes.description: Changes the arrow SVG path, like 'm7.61 0.807-2.12...'. The SVG size must be 40×40.

attributes.name: interval
attributes.description: The autoplay interval in milliseconds.

attributes.name: pauseOnHover
attributes.description: Determines whether to pause autoplay on mouseover or not.

attributes.name: pauseOnFocus
attributes.description: Determines whether to pause autoplay while the carousel contains the active element (focused element).

attributes.name: resetProgress
attributes.description: Determines whether to reset the autoplay progress when it is requested to start again.

attributes.name: lazyLoad
attributes.description: Enables lazy loading. Accepts true | false | 'nearby' | 'sequential'

attributes.name: preloadPages
attributes.description: Determines how many pages (not slides) around the active slide should be loaded beforehand.

attributes.name: wheel
attributes.description: Enables navigation by the mouse wheel. To use this option, set waitForTransition to be true and/or give wheelSleep duration, otherwise your carousel will immediately reach the end.

attributes.name: wheelMinThreshold
attributes.description: The threshold to cut off the small delta produced by inertia scroll.

attributes.name: wheelSleep
attributes.description: The sleep duration in milliseconds until accepting next wheel. The timer starts when the transition begins.

attributes.name: releaseWheel
attributes.description: Determines whether to release the wheel event when the carousel reaches the first or last slide so that the user can scroll the page continuously.

attributes.name: slideFocus
attributes.description: Determines whether to add tabindex="0" to visible slides or not.

attributes.name: focusableNodes
attributes.description: A selector for focusable nodes inside slides.

attributes.name: isNavigation
attributes.description: If true, the carousel makes slides clickable to navigate another carousel.

attributes.name: trimSpace
attributes.description: Determines whether to trim spaces before/after the carousel if the focus option is available.

attributes.name: updateOnMove
attributes.description: Updates the is-active status of slides just before moving the carousel.

attributes.name: mediaQuery
attributes.description: If min, the media query for breakpoints will be min-width, or otherwise, max-width.

attributes.name: live
attributes.description: Enables a live region. If isNavigation is enabled, Splide won't activate it.

attributes.name: destroy
attributes.description: Destroys the carousel

attributes.name: omitEnd
attributes.description: If true, omits some pagination dots which just changes the active slide and do not move a carousel. Also, disables a next arrow when a carousel reaches the last page.

attributes.name: TimeFormat
attributes.description:
Set the input time format. If empty, the time format will be defined based on the Is24Hours parameter. Here is a list of formatting tokens that you can use:

H → Hours (24 hours)
h → Hours (12 hours)
G → Hours (12 hours), 2 digits with leading zeros
i → Minutes
s → Seconds
S → Seconds, 2 digits with leading zeros
K → AM/PM

You may escape formatting tokens using \\.

Examples:
“H:i” → 15:30
“G:i K” → 03:30 PM
”h\\hi\\m K” → 3h30m PM
”H \\ho\\ur\\s i \\m\\i\\n\\ute\\s” → 15 hours 30 minutes

inputParameters.description:
Set the input time format. If empty, the time format will be defined based on the Is24Hours parameter.

i → Minutes
s → Seconds

K → AM/PM

“G:i K” → 03:30 PM

Numbers/ProgressBar.name: ProgressBar
Numbers/ProgressBar.description:
You can use the ProgressBar to display the current progress in a bar.
When the update frequency is high (e.g., 2 or more updates per second), the default animation speed may appear sluggish. To address this, adjust the animation speed by modifying the following CSS variables: --progress-initial-speed and --progress-speed.

To override the default animation settings, use the following CSS:

.override-speed .osui-progress-bar {
    --progress-speed: 0.1s;         /* default: 0.35s */
    --progress-initial-speed: 0.2s; /* default: 0.5s  */
}

This customization ensures that the ProgressBar remains smooth and responsive, even at high update rates.

inputParameters.name: Progress
inputParameters.description: Progress percentage. Usually a number (integer) between 0 and 100. You can also use functions and local variables.

inputParameters.name: ProgressColor
inputParameters.description:
The color that fills the bar, as progress goes up. By default, the progress color is the primary color you chose when creating the app.

To use an RGB color, use: TextToIdentifier(“rgb(0,0,0)“)
To use an HEX color, use: TextToIdentifier(“#000000”)

inputParameters.name: TrailColor
inputParameters.description:
The color of the empty part of the bar. By default,  the trail color is Neutral 4 (#DEE2E6). 

To use an RGB color, use: TextToIdentifier(“rgb(0,0,0)“)
To use an HEX color, use: TextToIdentifier(“#000000”)

inputParameters.name: Thickness
inputParameters.description: Sets the height of the ProgressBar, in pixels. By default, the thickness is "12".

inputParameters.name: OptionalConfigs
inputParameters.description: Sets additional parameters to customize the ProgressBar behavior and functionality.

- "myclass" - Adds the myclass style to the UI styles being applied.
- "myclass1 myclass2" - Adds the myclass1 and myclass2 styles to the UI styles being applied.
